([[Wolfeboro, New Hampshire]]) | college = [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]] (2015–2017) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = *First-team All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] (2017) }} '''Donovan Mitchell''' (born September 7, 1996) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played college basketball for the [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville Cardinals]]. Mitchell attended [[Canterbury School]] in [[New Milford, Connecticut]] for his sophomore year of high school[http://247sports.com/Player/Donovan-Mitchell-35404?PlayerInstitution=58484] before transferring to [[Brewster Academy]] in [[Wolfeboro, New Hampshire]] for his junior and senior years.[http://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/recruiting/louisville/2015/01/18/donovan-mitchell-uses-senior-year-brewster-academy-prepare-louisville-basketball/21969959/ Donovan Mitchell preps for U of L career] Along with basketball, he also played baseball in high school for two years, but focused on Basketball when he went to Brewster, a move which garnered him more attention from college basketball coaches.[http://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2016/10/26/louisville-basketball-donovan-mitchell-baseball-star/92772200/Donovan Mitchell: Baseball star? ][http://www.nydailynews.com/sports/college/baseball-injury-led-donovan-mitchell-louisville-stardom-article-1.3000598 How a baseball injury led Connecticut native Donovan Mitchell to star for Louisville hoops under Rick Pitino] He committed to the [[University of Louisville]] to play [[college basketball]].[http://www.si.com/college-basketball/2014/08/08/donovan-mitchell-commits-louisville Four-star guard Donovan Mitchell commits to Louisville] As a freshman at Louisville, Mitchell averaged 7.4 points, 1.7 assists and 3.4 rebounds per game.[http://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2016/11/10/louisville-basketball-breakout-season-donovan-mitchell/93592260/ Is Donovan Mitchell Cards' next star?] As a sophomore, he averaged 15.6 points, 2.7 assists and 4.9 rebounds. After the season, he entered the [[2017 NBA draft]], but did not immediately hire an agent.[http://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2017/03/22/louisville-basketball-donovan-mitchell-declares-2017-nba-draft-wont-hire-agent/99504148/ Mitchell declares for NBA draft, won't hire agent][http://www.espn.co.uk/nba/story/_/id/18978079/donovan-mitchell-louisville-cardinals-enter-nba-draft Donovan Mitchell to enter draft, but may return to Louisville] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.gocards.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=6474 Louisville Cardinals bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Mitchell, Donovan}} [[Category:1996 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Guards (basketball)]] [[Category:Louisville Cardinals men's basketball players]]
